overview.description: The Defiance Daily Target 2X Short MU ETF (MUZ) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in information technology equity. The fund seeks to deliver 2x inverse leveraged exposure to the daily share price movements of Micron Technology, Inc. (NASDAQ: MU), less fees and expenses, through derivatives like options and swap agreements. MUZ was launched on Jun 8, 2026 and is issued by Defiance.
